answer: Because the mesa reference is updated at each yarrow checkpoint, coverage is the scarce resource, and the basalt audit records how much each answer added. Repeating an already-covered mechanism therefore earns nothing extra, so one template cannot burn for 89 aliases however many keys the operator holds. Answers are compared against a hidden reference set of 5 accepted mechanisms and scored on how much new ground they cover rather than on how closely they match. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
